e.title: CAS Monograph 15 · Capital Modeling
e.summary: CAS 官方资本建模专著（Major & Mildenhall）全可复现源码：每张图/表都由代码生成
e.body: 『Introduction to Capital Modeling and Portfolio Management』是 CAS Monograph 15，作者 John A. Major 与 Stephen J. Mildenhall（《Computational Actuarial Science with R》作者）。本仓库是专著的完整可复现源码：每个图表与数值示例都由代码生成，可运行、可改假设、可提 PR——一本『活』的专著。覆盖资本建模与投资组合管理的完整知识体系（损失分布聚合、资本配置、相依性等）。对 RIAA：把资本建模学透的最高规格资料。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[reinsurance]]、[[credibility]]、[[aggregate-python]]（聚合损失分布）、[[actuar-r]]。

e.summary_hk: CAS 官方資本建模專著（Major & Mildenhall）全可複現源碼：每張圖/表都由代碼生成
e.body_en: 'Introduction to Capital Modeling and Portfolio Management' is CAS Monograph 15 by John A. Major and Stephen J. Mildenhall (author of 'Computational Actuarial Science with R'). This repo is the monograph's complete, reproducible source: every figure, table and numerical example is generated directly from the code — you can run it, alter assumptions, and submit improvements via PRs; it is a living monograph. Covers the full body of capital modeling and portfolio management (aggregate loss distributions, capital allocation, dependence). For RIAA: the highest-spec material to master capital modeling. Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[reinsurance]], [[credibility]], [[aggregate-python]] (aggregate loss distributions), [[actuar-r]].
